name: Snapshot Enumeration
description: The process of listing or retrieving metadata about existing snapshots in a cloud environment. *Data Collection Measures:* - AWS CloudTrail - Logs API calls such as `DescribeSnapshots`, `ListSnapshots`, and `GetSnapshotAttributes`. - Azure Monitor Logs - Tracks snapshot enumeration via `Microsoft.Compute/snapshots/read`. - Google Cloud Logging - Detects snapshot listing through `compute.disks.listSnapshots`.
